title: Practice 1: Moving in, out and up

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вбежа́ть (“to come running in, to come rushing in, to run (into)”)?
options: the manner of an action, given by the base word
giving or acquiring a status or state
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вбежа́ть under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: He kicked in a lot of money.
exercises.why: **вложил** — вложи́ть (perfective): to enclose, to insert, to put in; to sheathe; to embed; to invest, to deposit; to contribute. Wiktionary: в- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does в- add in войти́ (“to enter, to go in(to) (by foot), to get in(to)”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists войти́ under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).
**войти** — войти́ (perfective): to enter, to go in(to) (by foot), to get in(to); to penetrate into; to be included in; (computing) to log in. Wiktionary: во- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
